ink.$description: Ink — Primary text, all borders, card outlines, link color, arrow glyphs, V—A—C registration marks

paper.$description: Paper — Hairline borders, dividers, input outlines, and card edges on light surfaces. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

graphite.$description: Graphite — Diagonal category watermarks on cards, subtle decorative strokes — the only third tone in the system

diagramatika-text.$description: Body copy, metadata links, card titles, list items, navigation, all UI text. The only weight used is 400 — no bold, no medium, no light. This even single-weight voice is the defining typographic choice: nothing shouts, everything reads at the same conversational volume.

diagramatika-display.$description: Larger headings, hero text, featured card titles. Despite the name, used at the same 400 weight as body — the distinction is size and tight line-height (0.88–0.90) which lets lines of large type lock together into a dense block. The absence of weight contrast between display and text is anti-convention; most systems use 600-700 for headings.
